Question Choices: Select which fraction is smaller 2/5 or 4/5 ~~2/5 | 4/5~~
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, equal denominators mean equal-sized pieces. Compare the numerators.
Solution: Both fractions count fifths. Since 2 < 4, 2/5 is smaller than 4/5.

Question Choices: Select which fraction is larger 5/6 or 5/8 ~~5/6 | 5/8~~
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, a larger positive denominator means smaller pieces. Compare the same positive number of those pieces.
Solution: Sixths are larger than eighths of the same whole. With five pieces in each, 5/6 > 5/8.
